title: Coca Cola and Mustafa are the best!
text: I highly recommend Coca-Cola on your next tour to Morocco. He was very informative, knowledgeable, kind, and always there to attend to your needs. He went above and beyond what was advertised on Viator. I also recommend Mustafa, our driver. Funny guy and was very safe and excellent driver from start to finish . Overall, I really like our tour to Morocco. Ask for Coca-Cola and Mustafa on your next tour! Thank you again Coca-Cola and Mustafa. See you next time! 😁
author: Michelle_V

title: Tangier Trip
text: Camel ride and seeing the local markets. our guide Coke Cola did a nice job. Ali the owner was in constant communication. The entire day went well from pick up at hotel to delivery back to hotel.
author: Michael_G
